pages.text: A $(thing)contraption$() is a group of blocks moved as one: a drill carrying platform, a farm that drives itself, a train car. Glue and chassis decide what comes along; a mover decides how.

pages.title: Super Glue
pages.text: Bonds blocks into a shape. Blocks that hang on others need none. Click two corners to define an area.

pages.title: Linear Chassis
pages.text: Glues a row of blocks along its axis. The Radial Chassis grabs a disc around its axis. Both work with wrench settings and chassis ranges.
$(thing)Movers$():$(br2)$(li)Piston: pushes along a line$(br2)$(li)Rope Pulley: up and down$(br2)$(li)Gantry: slides on a shaft$(br2)$(li)Bearing: spins$(br2)$(li)Cart Assembler: rides a minecart

pages.title: Mechanical Bearing
pages.text: Rotates a structure, for windmills, rotating drills and turntables. The Clockwork Bearing makes clock hands.

$(thing)Working parts$(): Mechanical Drills, Saws, Harvesters and Ploughs do their job to whatever they pass. Deployers and funnels on the structure pull from and push into storage that moves with it.$(br2)Storage on a contraption is a chest or vault attached to the structure.

pages.title: Mechanical Drill
pages.text: Breaks blocks in front of it, also while moving. Harvesters cut crops, Ploughs till soil.
$(thing)Bigger things$(): Create Aeronautics builds flying ships out of the same idea, see $(l:flight/airships)Airships$(/l). Trains are contraptions too, see $(l:transport/trains)Trains$(/l).
